sentences.en: Nurture strength of spirit to shield you in sudden misfortune.
sentences.zh: 培养精神力量以在突如其来的不幸中保护自己。

sentences.en: I want my boss to shield me from unnecessary stuff.
sentences.zh: 我希望我的老板能为我挡掉不必要的事情。

sentences.en: Sami wanted to shield his daughter from Western ways.
sentences.zh: 萨米希望女儿不受西方生活方式的影响。
